adversarialCasesVerified: A. Zero snapshot: header exists with 0 nights -> not effective, seal fails with REVISION_SEAL_NIGHTS_COUNT_MISMATCH
B. Partial snapshot: 1 of 3 nights inserted -> not effective, seal fails with REVISION_SEAL_NIGHTS_COUNT_MISMATCH
C. Gapped snapshot: dates with missing day -> seal fails with REVISION_SEAL_DATES_INCOMPLETE
D. Out-of-range date: stay_date outside [check_in, check_out) -> rejected with REVISION_NIGHT_DATE_OUT_OF_RANGE
E. Header/night room-type mismatch -> rejected structurally by composite FK (23503)
F. Inventory-day / date mismatch -> rejected with REVISION_NIGHT_DATE_INVENTORY_MISMATCH
G. Inventory-day / room-type mismatch -> rejected with REVISION_NIGHT_ROOM_TYPE_INVENTORY_MISMATCH
H. Root listing / room-type mismatch -> rejected with REVISION_ROOM_TYPE_LISTING_MISMATCH
I. Valid complete snapshot before seal -> visible as ASSEMBLING in all_revisions, NOT effective
J. Valid seal -> commits successfully, V2 becomes effective, allocation matches snapshot
K. Post-seal append -> rejected with CANONICAL_RESERVATION_REVISION_SEALED
L. Post-seal update -> rejected with CANONICAL_RESERVATION_REVISION_IMMUTABLE
M. Post-seal delete -> rejected with CANONICAL_RESERVATION_REVISION_IMMUTABLE
N. Seal update/delete -> rejected with CANONICAL_RESERVATION_REVISION_SEAL_IMMUTABLE
O. Higher unsealed version -> V3 unsealed does NOT mask sealed V2
P. Concurrent append vs seal -> header row lock serializes operations, preventing phantom appends
Q. Physical inventory -> booked_units exactly unchanged (delta = 0)
Offer-scope adversarial 1: same listing, wrong room -> rejected with REVISION_OFFER_ROOM_TYPE_MISMATCH
Offer-scope adversarial 2: wrong listing -> rejected with REVISION_OFFER_LISTING_MISMATCH
Offer-scope positive control: matching offer -> sealed successfully and became effective
Partial offer binding: offer_id without revision or revision without offer_id rejected by CHECK constraint (23514); ENCHO_DIRECT rejects partial offer at trigger boundary
Absent offer binding: external origin with offer_id = NULL and offer_revision = NULL seals without inventing offer
